$comment: Product metadata for listing and catalogue use. Not read by the engine.

positioning.unit_of_planning: the deep-work project, run across thirteen weeks
positioning.scope: one body of hard work — named, scheduled, logged, and reviewed to completion
positioning.one_line: For work that takes months: one project, a defended weekly hour target, a session log that records output rather than effort, and thirteen weeks of evidence.

primary: Anyone with a long project and a full calendar

differentiators: One project, thirteen weeks — the planner has an arc, not just pages
Weekly band allocation rather than a daily hour grid
Session log records what was produced, not how long you sat
Flow State Tracker across fourteen sessions — conditions, not feelings
Distraction Elimination Tracker records countermeasures and whether they held
Interruptions logged by source and frequency per week, not as single events
Completion Review run at each milestone
Progress Dashboard: target hours against actual, thirteen weeks
Four sizes, verified page and link parity
Undated — reusable for the next project

differs_from.009-focus-planner: CLOSEST NEIGHBOUR. 009 plans a single session and what protects it; this plans a project across thirteen weeks. Shared page names run at different granularity throughout. Listing copy must state this.
differs_from.005-goal-planner: Any goal, including ones needing no deep work; this is specifically for work requiring long uninterrupted blocks
differs_from.006-weekly-productivity-planner: General weekly output; this defends hours for one project only
differs_from.007-daily-productivity-planner: Plans a whole day of mixed work; this plans one project's hours
differs_from.008-time-blocking-planner: Allocates every slot in the calendar; this allocates only the deep bands

compatibility.print: 100% scale, no bleed required, 100–120 gsm recommended
